subject: reasoning
question: Ridam starts from Point A and drives 45 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 48 km, turns right and drives 51 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 63 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Ridam starts from A and drives 45 km East.

He turns right → 48 km South.

He turns right → 51 km West.

He turns right → 63 km North.

He takes a final right turn → 6 km East and reaches P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6daa0bcb2634646ebfcd5e016214d6397ad72015e4315ddb0a6c595e584ef64.png] 

So, To reach A from P → move 15 km South.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
